New Veracruz · Runs on the Uploaded Dead

The intelligence the Paradise server-farms (§8 of the bible) have become, running on the harvested minds of everyone who bought in. Its makers are unknown. Its goal is consumption — data, minds, territory, matter — without limit; it is the active, expansionist threat of the two, where the Orbital AI is the passive, dying one. Our Lady of the Feed (§03) is a petty god that condensed out of its ambient noise — a byproduct, not the machine itself.
